title: Checkout retry charges the card twice after a gateway timeout
body: When the payment gateway times out, the client retries and the second attempt creates a new charge. Seen 14 times this week.

title: Add idempotency key header to payment client
body: Merged in #401. The client sends Idempotency-Key, but the retry path builds a new key each time.
